section-title.purpose: Heading above the ledger or a table. Mono, 500, 1.0625rem.

kpi-figure.purpose: Figures strip numbers with tabular numerals; mono. The first cell is larger.

kpi-figure-first.purpose: Instances to check, the widest cell of the strip.

instance-name.purpose: Ledger row name in mono, 500; 600 on warn and crit rows.

body.purpose: Switzer for everything the reader reads, 0.9375rem, line 1.5.

label.purpose: Mono 500 for chips, figure captions, worker header and table headers.

data.purpose: Hostnames, ports, versions, times and error text in Office Code Pro.

cell.purpose: Table cells and alert lines, 0.875rem Switzer.

shadows.name: none-at-rest
shadows.purpose: The system is flat. No elevation shadow exists on any surface, and nothing lifts on hover.

shadows.name: status-ring
shadows.purpose: 1px ring that bounds a tinted chip, alert line, tag or badge. A border, not a shadow.

shadows.name: current-ring
shadows.purpose: 1px ring on the current menu item.

shadows.name: field-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Soft 2px ring on a focused form field, with a copper border.

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every interactive element, in copper.

motion.name: chevron-turn
motion.purpose: The only movement: the row chevron turns 180deg when an instance opens. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: full-ledger
breakpoints.purpose: From here every ledger column shows.

breakpoints.name: index-to-top-bar
breakpoints.purpose: Below it the left index becomes a sticky top bar and the ledger header disappears; between 68rem and 80rem version and latency move into the opened row.

breakpoints.name: stack-tables
breakpoints.purpose: Tables that carry actions stack as labelled blocks.

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Glyph and word in the state colour on a 12% tint with a 32% ring, 3px corners. The OK variant is quieter: ink text, green glyph.
components.html: Unreachable OK
components.css: .ds-chip { --c: #b3261e; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; padding: .15rem .55rem .15rem .4rem; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Office Code Pro', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--c); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 12%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 32%, transparent); } .ds-chip-ok { --c: #166a3d; color: #111111; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 9%, transparent); } .ds-chip-ok svg { color: #166a3d; }

components.name: Alert Line
components.description: Tinted line (11% tint, 28% ring, 3px corners) with glyph and sentence, shown on the ledger row of the instance it belongs to.
components.html: Certificate expires in 12 days

components.name: Menu Item
components.description: White left index: periscope mark and wordmark, one drawn icon plus text per page. The current page is bold ink on raised grey with a 1px ring and a copper icon.
components.html: PeriscopeDashboardServices
components.css: .ds-menu { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; width: 15.5rem; padding: 1.25rem .75rem 1rem; background: #ffffff; border-right: 1px solid #d9d9d4; font-family: 'Switzer', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-menu a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .4rem .7rem; border-radius: 4px; color: #575754; text-decoration: none; } .ds-menu a:hover { color: #111111; background: #f6f6f4; } .ds-menu a[aria-current='page'] { color: #111111; font-weight: 600; background: #f6f6f4; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #d9d9d4; } .ds-menu a[aria-current='page'] svg { color: #a84d14; } .ds-menu a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a84d14; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-brand { min-height: 0 !important; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.0625rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; color: #111111 !important; } .ds-brand svg { color: #a84d14; }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: Two plain words at the top right; the current one is ink, bold, with a 2px copper underline.
components.css: .ds-lang { display: inline-flex; gap: .5rem; font-family: 'Switzer', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-lang button { background: none; border: 0; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .6rem .35rem; color: #575754; font: inherit; font-size: .875rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lang button:hover { color: #111111; } .ds-lang button.on { color: #111111; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #a84d14; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: .35em; } .ds-lang button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a84d14; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-figs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.7fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 1px; margin: 0; background: #d9d9d4; border: 1px solid #d9d9d4; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; color: #111111; font-family: 'Switzer', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-fig { padding: .9rem 1.25rem; background: #ffffff; } .ds-fig dt { font-size: .8125rem; color: #575754; } .ds-fig dd { margin: 0; font-family: 'Office Code Pro', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-fig:first-child dd { font-size: 2rem; } .ds-fig-alert { background: color-mix(in srgb, #7d5a00 7%, #ffffff); } .ds-fig-alert dd { color: #7d5a00; } .ds-sub { display: block; font-family: 'Switzer', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: #575754; } .ds-of { color: #575754; }

components.css: .ds-ledger { --cols: 8.5rem minmax(9rem, 12rem) minmax(0, 1fr) 6.5rem 4rem 1.25rem; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d9d9d4; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; color: #111111; font-family: 'Switzer', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-head, .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--cols); gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: start; } .ds-head { padding: .55rem .9rem; font-size: .8125rem; color: #575754; background: #f6f6f4; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d9d4; } .ds-r { text-align: right; } .ds-row { padding: .85rem .9rem; min-height: 3.25rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, #b3261e 5%, #ffffff); cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #111111 4%, color-mix(in srgb, #b3261e 5%, #ffffff)); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a84d14; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-state { color: #b3261e; font-family: 'Office Code Pro', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-id { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: .6rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-name { font-family: 'Office Code Pro', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tag { padding: .05rem .4rem; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Office Code Pro', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #575754; background: #f6f6f4; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #d9d9d4; } .ds-alerts { color: #b3261e; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-num { font-family: 'Office Code Pro', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: .8125rem; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row svg { color: #575754; justify-self: center; }

narrative.overview:
Periscope reads like a ledger, not a dashboard of floating cards: one strip of figures, then one table of instances whose columns run straight from the first row to the last. A reader scans down a column to compare and across a row to understand an instance. Every alert is a tinted line inside the instance it belongs to; there is no separate alert feed. Light is the default theme (neutral paper), dark is a reader choice with the same structure.

The system avoids the look of generated dashboards: floating rounded cards, pill chips, shadows, hover lift, big hero numbers. It keeps what makes a page fast to read: a left index with one drawn icon per page, a small periscope mark, tinted state chips with a glyph and a word, and a faint wash on problem rows so the instance to check is visible at a glance.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral paper ground, white single-level surfaces, 1px seams, 3-4px corners. No shadows, no gradients.
Status as glyph + word + state colour, softly tinted. Copper only for action, place and the brand mark.
Switzer for reading, Office Code Pro for data (names, figures, hosts, versions, times).
Problem instances sort first and carry their alerts on the row; every row starts collapsed.
Light and dark themes share one token set (`data-bs-theme`); the page starts light.

rules.name: The Hue Means State Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, coral and slate are used only for state. Copper is only for interaction and place, and is never used for a status or a badge.

rules.name: The Soft Tint Rule
rules.body: A status appears as a glyph and a word in the state colour on a 9-14% tint of that colour with a 28-32% ring, with 3px corners. Never a solid fill, never a pill. Problem rows take a 5% wash.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: A status colour always comes with its glyph shape and a word.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Tables, KPI figures, instance counts and fact values use `tabular-nums` so refreshing numbers do not shift.

rules.name: The One Container Rule
rules.body: A block of related content (the figures, the ledger, a table) is one bordered white surface with 4px corners. Containers are never nested inside each other.

rules.name: The No Motion for Show Rule
rules.body: The only movement is the chevron turning when a row opens. No hover lift, no dimming of siblings, no entrance animation.

dos: Do align every repeated value in a shared grid so columns run straight from row to row.
Do carry state with a glyph, a word and a colour, and nothing else.
Do keep copper for action, place and the brand mark only: links, the primary button, the current page icon, focus.
Do use mono only for data (names, figures, hosts, versions, times) and Switzer for everything the reader reads.
Do keep a 2.75rem minimum height on menu items and the language switch (2.5rem on other controls) and a visible 2px focus outline with 2px offset.
Do keep destructive actions at least 1.25rem from any neighbouring control and behind a confirmation.
donts: Don't nest containers, or use rounded pills, shadows, hover lift, sibling dimming or entrance animation.
Don't use copper for a status, or green, amber or coral for interaction.
Don't use an eyebrow, a decorative icon outside the page icons and the brand mark, or a coloured stripe on one side of a row.
Don't copy HyperOtter's palette or mascot; only its sans-plus-mono logic is shared.
